fundamentals.name: Spotify Technology S.A.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Spotify Technology S.A., together with its subsidiaries, provides audio streaming subscription services worldwide. It operates in two segments, Premium and Ad-Supported. The Premium segment offers online and offline streaming access to its catalog of music and podcasts, including video, lossless music, and audiobooks in select markets through subscription offerings primarily sold directly to end users and partners. The Ad-Supported segment provides limited on-demand online access to its catalog of music and online and offline access to its catalog of podcasts on computers, tablets, mobile devices, and other smart devices. The company also offers sales, distribution and marketing, contract research and development, and customer and other support services. Spotify Technology S.A. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.

judgment.summary: Spotify demonstrates robust growth and strong profitability, though with significant leverage and a premium valuation.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter beat estimates by 18.0%; next earnings date is 2026-07-28.
positives: Earnings growth of 222.4% YoY and quarterly earnings growth of 220.4% indicate strong bottom-line expansion.
Operating margin of 15.8% and profit margin of 15.4% show healthy profitability.
Return on equity at 38.0% and return on assets at 11.6% reflect efficient use of capital.
Strong free cash flow of $707.75M (TTM) supports financial flexibility.
Analyst consensus is a strong buy with a high mean target of $607.36.
negatives: Debt/Equity ratio of 5.94 indicates significant leverage.
Forward P/E of 26.41 and PEG ratio of 1.64 suggest a premium valuation.
Revenue growth of 8.2% YoY is modest compared to earnings growth.
Beta of 1.55 indicates higher volatility than the broader market.

news.paragraph: Spotify shares experienced a notable decline of 3.4% on June 11th, despite some analysts maintaining a positive outlook and the stock outperforming a falling market on June 10th. This price action comes after a significant drop of 14% year-to-date, with recent reports highlighting both positive analyst sentiment and market concerns. The company's upcoming earnings report on July 28th will be crucial for assessing its performance and future trajectory.
